cross_domain.note: a compound of length k needs all k templates in the tester vocabulary; the only cross-domain overlap is scaffolding tools, so exposure is zero by vocabulary, not by transfer failure. Task ids also collide, so an id join across domains would silently pair unrelated tasks.

provenance.note: the numeric payload is a deterministic function of the corpus (pinned by corpus_sha256); git_rev and dirty record the checkout and change by design
